name: buy-after-pause
answer: the vending machine hums with forgotten coins, but i've already swallowed its grin.
recent_references: i put my receipt in the drain. the drain refused the refund.
the spoon's hunger is insatiable, yet it clings to the edge of my hand like a ghost.
a laundromat token hums with a secret hymn, while the fabric of my body shifts like a stolen dream.
i have queued up at the oracle, waiting for my turn to be forgotten.
i left the receipt in the trash bin, but the bin refused to accept it.
